prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE extremely polished, realistic desktop web application screenshot for a human-first sprite animation editor named "Sprite Workbench". Landscape 16:10, ideally 1920x1200, full-bleed application screenshot, no laptop, no browser address bar, no surrounding presentation page, no perspective. This is a working creative tool, not a marketing landing page or dashboard. Crisp readable Simplified Chinese UI typography in Source Han Sans style, modest 14-16px equivalent labels and 22px headings, precise thin dividers, small 6px corner radii. Use warm light gray #F4F5F2 chrome, nearly white #FFFFFF side panels, charcoal #252B2B drawing surfaces with subtle transparency checkerboard #303636, deep charcoal #24312E text, muted teal #167D72 primary buttons and selected outlines, restrained amber for unsaved states. Flat professional aesthetic with almost no shadows, no gradients, no purple, no excessive cards. Space-efficient but legible. Consistent sample character throughout the screenshot: a cute short round orange fox with cream muzzle, pointed ears, two small dark eyes, dark teal short poncho and little brown satchel, hand-painted 2D game sprite, three-quarter view, consistent proportions and palette. All character images are sample artwork, not actual user's assets. Use real purposeful sprite editing controls, no graphs or generic statistics. Never show code, JSON, terminal, pipeline internals, or source/processed folder jargon. Top application bar: small geometric sprite logo, "Sprite Workbench", breadcrumb "我的工程 / 森林信使", compact undo redo, saved/unsaved state, quiet "Agent 助手" entry. Second bar provides contextual workflow tabs "角色基准", "切割", "调整", "动作", "导出". Subtle small text "界面概念 · 示例工程" in the bottom status bar. Exact Chinese text should be rendered clearly and correctly. SCREEN 1: Character baseline and project entry, active tab "角色基准". Left panel 220px: project switcher "森林信使", small "＋ 新建工程" link, then navigation sections "角色资料", selected "人设与基准", "原图素材", "动作列表" with idle / walk / jump rows and tiny thumbnails. Main area wide, uncluttered split comparison: heading "先确认角色，再开始创作", short subtitle "后续动作沿用同一套形象与比例". Left main column titled "人设参考" shows an artboard with coherent front and side design drawings of the orange fox in teal poncho, small palette swatches and "导入参考图" button. Center main column titled "IDLE 基准" shows one large full-body approved fox idle pose on dark transparent checkerboard; below a check badge "已设为基准" and small secondary "查看原图" and "更换基准". Below these, a horizontal row titled "候选版本" with exactly three image thumbnails "版本 1", "版本 2", "版本 3"; version 2 visibly selected with teal outline and a check. Right properties panel 300px titled "角色约定" with a square thumbnail and "森林信使", then readable fields "朝向  右前方", "画布  640 × 640", palette swatches "配色", a small body-proportion diagram beside "保持头身比例", ground line graphic labelled "脚底基准"; divider; quiet button "让 Agent 生成候选"; primary button at bottom "导入动作原图 →". Make human approval prominent and Agent subordinate. No time chart. The approved pose is one static key pose, do not pretend it is the entire animated idle action.
